SAME OPERATION
(same behaviour as the pre-fix code: a forwarded/collected finding located only by a pointer into the document it graded, needing the sibling filename stitched on so the message/path stays locatable once merged into a package-level report)

- packages/validator/src/analitiq/validator/connectors.py:993-1006 `_load_json_sibling` — on an unreadable/unparseable sibling, builds `message=f"sibling {path.name} ..."`, naming the sibling inline. This is the pre-existing "loader's own findings" convention the commit's `_read_from` explicitly says it is now matching.
- packages/validator/src/analitiq/validator/connectors.py:325-341 `_embedded_schema_findings` — takes a `label` (endpoint filename) and builds `where = f"{label}{pointer}"` so a JSON-Schema defect names the endpoint file it came from.
- packages/validator/src/analitiq/validator/connectors.py:344-486 `_embedded_schema_example_findings` — same `label`-threading pattern (`where = _bounded(f"{label}{entry}" ...)`) for sample-vs-schema findings.
- packages/validator/src/analitiq/validator/connectors.py:723-755 `_endpoint_transport_ref_findings` — labels the endpoint side (`where = f"{label}{pointer}"`) and also names the sibling by hand on the connector side (`"is not declared in the sibling connector.json ..."`).
- packages/validator/src/analitiq/validator/connectors.py:1430-1521 `_validate_api_endpoint` — resolves `connector.json` as a sibling and writes `notApplicable`/`fail` findings that spell out `"the sibling connector.json ..."` in the message by hand, same problem the commit's `_read_from` now solves generically for type-map findings.
- plugins/analitiq-pipeline-builder/scripts/validate.py:231-305 `_connection_type_map_findings` — collects type-map findings via `_type_map_findings(doc, path)` and re-roots each one with `findings.extend({**f, "path": f"{site}/{fname}{f.get('path','')}"} for f in ...)`. Same operation as `_read_from`, but rewrites `path` instead of prefixing `message`.
- plugins/analitiq-pipeline-builder/scripts/validate.py:308-316 `_at_site` — general-purpose re-rooting helper ("Re-root a member's own findings at the file they came from"); its docstring explicitly cites `_connection_type_map_findings` as sharing its shape, confirming this is the established idiom on the pipeline-builder side of the same problem the commit fixes on the connector side.
